news.title: Global Market: European shares flat as oil prices offset bond market relief
news.description: European shares remained flat on Thursday as rising crude oil prices and inflation worries counteracted a recovery in global bond markets following US Treasury intervention. German bond yields hit 15-year highs while travel and mining stocks fell.

news.title: Global Market: Eurozone bond yields ease as US Treasury moves to support long-dated debt
news.description: Eurozone government bond yields edged lower as markets took cues from the US Treasury’s decision to expand liquidity operations for longer-dated debt. German bond yields also declined, while investors continued to price elevated expectations for an ECB rate hike amid persistent inflation concerns.
